Google measures this under Total Blocking Time (TBT) and Interaction to Next Paint (INP).
If your site has high blocking time, you are actively frustrating your highest-intent buyers at the exact moment they try to take action.

Our studio engineers for zero blocking time:
Scripts are deferred, assets are optimized, and interaction handlers respond in under 50 milliseconds.

In Google's modern search algorithm, technical performance is no longer an optional recommendation.
It is an explicit ranking signal known as Core Web Vitals.

Google evaluates three critical metrics for every URL on the web:

1. LCP (Largest Contentful Paint):
How fast does the main visual block load? (Standard: Under 2.5 seconds).
2. INP (Interaction to Next Paint):
How responsive is the page when a user interacts with it? (Standard: Under 200 milliseconds).
3. CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift):
Does the page jump or shift around while loading, causing accidental misclicks? (Standard: Under 0.1).

If your website fails these three thresholds:
Google actively demotes your search visibility in local mobile search results—even if you have great backlinks and content.

At Uncoded Hub, every single 7-Day Sprint is engineered to pass all three Core Web Vitals thresholds on mobile before a single line of code goes live.

Here is the exact 7-point engineering checklist we run on every Uncoded Hub asset before deployment:

1. Image Transcoding: All raster images converted to WebP/AVIF format with exact dimensions specified to eliminate Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
2. Font Subsetting: Custom web fonts subsetted to only include needed glyphs, preloaded with `font-display: swap` to prevent invisible text during load.
3. CSS Delivery: Critical path CSS inlined in the document head; non-critical styles loaded asynchronously.
4. JavaScript Deferral: Zero blocking scripts in document head; all interactive modules deferred and loaded at the end of execution.
5. DOM Minimization: Flat semantic DOM trees with fewer than 800 total nodes per page to reduce memory consumption on low-end mobile devices.
6. Cache Headers: Aggressive Cache-Control headers configured on edge servers with 1-year immutability for static hashed assets.
7. Compression: HTTP/3 enabled with Brotli compression applied to all text payloads.

This is why our client sites load in under 800 milliseconds while typical agency websites struggle to load in 5 seconds.

Engineering discipline over convenience. Every single time.
